mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 66 degrees under clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. We are under a waxing crescent moon, and the ISS will pass by at 4:47 AM, rising over Belleville and heading toward Fitchburg, staying low near the horizon. Expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall is preparing for the August 18 road construction project on Highway M, which will feature traffic shifts for utility work, and the Senior Center is accepting volunteer applications for those willing to commit to two shifts per month.
There is plenty to do around town, including the UGM at Epic Systems tomorrow, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on Tuesday.
On August 5, Verona police officers assisted the Department of Corrections in taking a Madison man into custody at a residence on Whalen Road after a brief foot pursuit.
Today's flavor is Mint Cookie, a classic crowd favorite. Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
